reviews.x: Made from potash alum, an alum block is an old staple in traditional barbershops and still in use in Europe. Its all-natural antiseptic properties work as an astringent that instantly closes razor nicks from shaving. soothes and cools razor burn when rubbed over the entire face after a shave.  Run it under cold water and lightly rub it over your face to soothe and cool razor burn after shaving. Alum was used by the Egyptians more than 4,000 years ago. If you find a cheaper brand it is OK, there

This works great on irritated skin and the block has lasted me 6 months, and will last much longer. It is soothing, though leaves a slight film.  While not visible, it does remain. Effective for nicks and cuts.  UPDATE (4/2011): I still have the block.  As I continued with wet shaving, I needed to use this less frequently.  However, the block has started to crumble on the edges.  I do believe it will continue to be useful for another 2 years though.

reviews.t: Best Potassium Alum I have ever purchased!
reviews.x: Cool and soothing after your shave (also has good anti-slip properties if you run on your fingers prior to to handling a metal razor handle, like my Merkur Progress). Also has very decent astringent properties. So it will stop light nicks/scratches from bleeding, but a full-on cut would still need a styptic, but I believe this is well within the scope of the product, so it does a little better than expected for alum vs, styptic. Great product; if I could, I would rate 6/5!

This is an alum block like many other alum blocks. It's small; I'd say the physical syze is about 2.5"x1.5"x1". If you have never used an alum block as an after shave or even a deoderant, this is a fantastic product. You will not regret this purchase.
Nothing complex about this thing.  Block of alum.  Can't really go wrong on that. Side note, it deteriorates like candy cane, so be weary of sharp edges as time goes by.

This product will make your pores look better after a week of use. I shave with a mechanical safety razor (i.e., one razor blade) and this has done wonders. I slap on hot water, apply Aveda Composition Pure-formance Oil on the shaving area, apply shaving cream, shave, rinse with warm water and get the block wet with warm water, rub it all over the face, and both sides of the neck (wetting as necessary), brush my teeth and let the water get cold, and then rinse it off with ice cold water. Finish

Husband bought this for his wet shaving.  Before he was sometimes having sensitive skin after a wet shave,  with this block you simply wet it and rub it on your face after each wet shave (before shaving if using electric).  It stings when you hit a cut, but in a good way he says!  Face is left feeling great after this, and no sensitive feeling at all!

Recieved this from my wife as a gift and I can honestly say I will never be without alum again. It not only helps with nicks and cuts but it seems to tone the skin as well. That coupled with it's antiseptic properties make for an exceptional shaving experience.
Great small block of alum, it works like it's supposed to and has a smooth surface as it glides across your freshly shaven face. The sting is perfect.
If you get razor burn/bumps, using this on irritated spots will def help!  I always have one in the vanity.

I'd never heard of an alum block until last year and decided to try this as I frequently have irritated skin and small nicks after shaving.  It works wonders as long as you leave it on long enough to work.  You can't be in a hurry and rush it or you are wasting your time.  I leave it on for about 5-7 minutes before rinsing it off my face and neck.  As it drys on your face, you'll notice how it cools the skin.  It reduces irritation better than after shave and helps to stop bleeding.  It stings a

I repeatedly saw alum as a recommendation on shaving sites and shaving tip videos. Having little lose, I gave it a try to combat my razor bumps.  The first time I tried this stuff it was AMAZING.  I used it before shaving, applying it before the creme, and the shave felt better, smoother, and closer.  Afterwards, I had less razor bumps and after a few months they had practically vanished.  So the least I can say is that it worked for me.  After losing it while traveling, I shaved without it for

reviews.t: A must have for the perfect shave.
reviews.x: Every man that shaves, no matter how its done, should use this after every time. This is the tool that a man needs to complete the shave and protect the skin. The previous one I had was smaller and when I accidentally dropped it in the sink it shattered. This one has survived the drop test with a tiny piece of a corner and nothing else. This will last a long, long time. Stop using pieces of tissue and such to stop the little bleeders. Get this instead and it will soon become your best friend aft

This is an excellent product.  Being new to wet shaving, I was unsure of the necessity of this little bar, but after the first shave I was sold on its value.  It does sting a little on application, however it is more of a refreshing feeling than pain.  It does an excellent job at stopping any irritation and bleeds of any nicks from the shave itself.  This is a must have for anyone who uses a razor.  It did not dry my skin or leave any smell.  Would buy again and recommend to anyone!

I use this as a post shave astringent and antiseptic.  It's easy to just wet the block and rub the block over the face.  It actually gives you feedback on your shaving technique and quality of your blade, since any areas where scraping took place will sting slightly.  It's also replaced my antiperspirant.  Same technique for application does the job and doesn't stain my shirts the way regular deodorant does.

reviews.t: Much less discomfort than a Styptic Pencil
reviews.x: This is a very nice product.  It is very small, but works great.  I use it by closing my pores with cold water and then gliding this block on my face after my shave.  Cooling feeling and a slight sting if you have cut yourself, but much less than a styptic pencil; which surprised me as I understood that a styptic pencil is made up mostly of Alum.

reviews.t: It works just like it should
reviews.x: Here's the thing: Alum is alum. What matters is the presentation. While TOBS Alum Block is a solid product, it's expensive for what it is and it comes in a cheap box, which means you'll have to find a case. It works just like it should, but you can find something that works just as well for less money and that comes in a case.

Been a few months now since I got it and I use it every other day, its an awesome product. I love using it because it help seal any nicks or cuts that I get when i shave with my razor and it tightens my skin. I recommended it to my family and friends if they decide to start shaving with a safety razor.

This block is smooth on the face and works great.  You can feel a slight stinging where the treatment is really needed.  My barber suggested I order an alum block.  Sad to say I waited several months before I took his advice.  I wish I had bought one of these years ago.  Comfortable!!!!

A small block of rock salt. Wet it and drag across your face after shaving. Any style of shaving. Small irritations and nicks burn for a microsecond and are gone. Rinse off and pat dry. This is the only thing you'll need before aftershave lotion. No staining. Nonsticky. No smell.
For an alum block, cant get better... or much worse, ha. Its an alum block! Simple, but this one is of very good quality still
Great stuff.  Tiny bar, can get more for less elsewhere.  Works like a charm though so I'm happy.

Being new to DE shaving I did not find out about Alum blocks until after a few months in. I use it after every shave and I have to say it has really helped heal my face, especially the sensitive parts of my neck. It gets 4 stars because the price is almost twice what it should be and it came in a cheap piece of cardboard. Razorock has one for a little more than half that comes with a travel case.

Another fantastic product from Taylor of Bond Street.  Just dip this eraser-sized block into a bit of water, and either apply it to a nick for about 30-45 seconds, or wipe across your face in lieu of aftershave, this product seals and stops bleeding quickly.  I wish I had discovered this product decades ago.  Sometimes there's no school like the old school!

After shaving with a safety razor, this is by far the best tool to stop any "weeping".  Seems to last forever, as well.  Has no smell so it won't clash with any cream or aftershave that you choose.  It won't stop actual cuts, but so far, I haven't found anything that will so I won't hold it against it.

claims.text: Reviewers widely report the alum block soothes irritated skin and razor burn and helps stop light nicks and cuts from bleeding.
Many users note a stinging sensation on application, especially on cuts or poorly shaved areas, which most describe as tolerable or even refreshing.
The block is praised for lasting a long time and being a simple, durable product.
A few reviewers mention minor drawbacks such as a slight film left on the skin or the block deteriorating with sharp edges over time.
Several reviewers say it tones the skin and improves the look of pores with regular use.
